subject: Coordination: Kadence technical demo + rotating overlap windows
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Emily White <emily.white@kadence.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:00:00 -0800
Subject: Coordination: Kadence technical demo + rotating overlap windows

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the interest and for lining up the team. To make progress on the demo and procurement/security pre-reads, I want to propose a rotating demo schedule that hits overlapping windows for Kadence's US, EU and APAC engineers without forcing anyone to be on a late-night one-off.

High-level ask: can we lock three 75-minute demo slots over two weeks, each intentionally timed to favor one region while ensuring an SE handover for follow-ups? That reduces repeated prep while giving each regional lead a convenient window.

Candidate windows (local / UTC):
- Option A (APAC-friendly): 09:00–10:15 SGT (01:00–02:15 UTC) — good for APAC engineers, SE available for notes
- Option B (EU-friendly): 13:00–14:15 CET (12:00–13:15 UTC) — hits EU midday overlap with east US late morning
- Option C (US-friendly): 16:00–17:15 PST (00:00–01:15 UTC next day) — US west coast prime time, EU can join morning

Proposed approach: we pick three dates across two weeks and rotate A→B→C so each region gets one convenient slot. Hiro will be our SE lead and Neha will coordinate procurement/security artifacts. I attached a quick overlap grid to compare local times.

Please let me know constraints (procurement windows, security review availability) and any blackout days next two weeks. If helpful, I can draft a canary calendar invite set with fallback SEs.

Thanks —
Grace
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: kadence-overlap-grid.xlsx (overview of local time conversions)

Hi Grace —

Thanks — this looks promising. A few constraints from our side:
- Our security lead (Shweta) is only available in EU mornings (08:00–11:00 CET) on Tue/Wed.
- Procurement can do contract/po alignment on Thursdays between 14:00–16:00 CET.
- We need at least one session where Rajiv (platform lead) can join live; his best slots are Tue/Thu 16:00–18:00 IST.

Not sure the perfect rotation exists given those constraints, but we can make it work with one EU-favoring session that includes security.

Looping in Rajiv to comment on his availability.

Best,
Emily

Hi all —

I can make the EU-friendly slot if we schedule it on a Tuesday or Thursday (16:00 IST works well). The APAC slot that lands at 01:00 UTC is tricky for me but not impossible if we make it daytime IST. Is there flexibility to shift APAC-friendly times to 11:00 SGT (03:30 UTC)?

Also, security has asked for a short pre-demo call to review the environment/connectivity checklist (SOC/SCA items) — can we schedule a 30-minute pre-call with Shweta and one of your SEs the week before the EU session?

-Rajiv

Thanks Rajiv — good notes. We can shift the APAC-friendly window later to make it work for IST. Revised candidate windows: 
- APAC-friendly revised: 11:00–12:15 SGT (03:00–04:15 UTC) — should be 08:30–09:45 IST (comfortable for Rajiv)
- EU-friendly: 13:00–14:15 CET (12:00–13:15 UTC) — schedule this on Tuesday to include Shweta
- US-friendly: 16:00–17:15 PST (00:00–01:15 UTC next day) — pick a Wednesday for broader west-coast participation

Proposed calendar:
- Week 1 Tue (EU-friendly with Security pre-call on Mon)
- Week 1 Wed (US-friendly)
- Week 2 Tue (APAC-friendly)

Hiro: can you own the pre-demo security sync with Shweta? If you can confirm a 30-minute slot the Monday before the EU session, I will send the pre-call invite + attach the security checklist. Neha — can you surface procurement PO timing so I can avoid a conflict on Thursday?

I will draft the rotating invites and include an explicit fallback SE (Hiro -> backup Neha) and a short agenda: 1) architecture + connectivity (20m), 2) demo (35m), 3) next steps & procurement path (20m).

Attaching ICS set and overlap grid in the next email.

Thanks —
Grace
